news.label: OpenFlaps released
points: Split-flap display you can run from Claude
STL and PCB files also released
details: Besides a web UI and a JSON API, an MCP server for controlling it from Claude is also available.
A Pico W connects over I2C to character modules built with an ATtiny84 and a stepper motor.
STL files, PCB manufacturing data, firmware, and an assembly guide are all included.

lines.say: First up, a mechanical split-flap display you can control from Claude. It's called Open Flaps.
lines.show: First up, a mechanical split-flap display you can control from Claude: OpenFlaps.

lines.say: The design files and assembly instructions are all public, and watching an AI's reply flip into place is a lot of fun.
lines.show: All design files and assembly steps are public, and watching AI replies flip into place is fun.

news.label: SenseTime releases robot AI
details: It switches between VLA-based motion generation and a control method where it writes its own code to calculate target positions.
These results come without extra training on real robots, and grasping and moving objects reportedly succeeded in 6 of 10 trials.
Note that the success rates are manufacturer-reported, from limited experiments.

lines.say: Without any extra training on real robots, it reportedly stacked blocks successfully nine times out of ten.

news.label: Video generation on Trainium3
details: In this example, a 10-second video with audio at 2048 by 1024 was generated using 32 NeuronCores.
The timings are measured after the model is loaded, and they don't reflect the performance of personal GPUs.
It also covers a method for building continuous scenes by referencing frames before and after each shot.

lines.say: Now for video generation. Hugging Face showed an example of making a ten-second video in about twenty-two seconds on Trainium three.
lines.show: Now, video generation. Hugging Face showed a 10-second video made in about 22 seconds on Trainium3.

news.label: Wanderer CAD update
points: Works with Blender 4.2 LTS or later
details: This GPL add-on brings Rhino and AutoCAD style command input, coordinate and dimension entry, snapping, and drawing output to Blender.
Version 2.96.130 improves switching between the standard and dedicated toolbars, along with choosing display tools.

news.label: ToughONE BlackS launches
points: Black added to the tough material line
details: It's a material for the PolyJet based J55 Prime, J55 Pro, and J35 Pro printers.
It can be used for appearance checks and functional testing of electronics enclosures, snap-fits, jigs, and more.
This is a new color for an existing material, not a resin for home MSLA printers.

lines.say: Last up, materials news from Japan. Stratasys Japan has added a black color to its tough material.
